# Open3DPP

> Open data standard for FFF/FDM polymer printing. A flat characterization
> schema: one row = one observation of a material — a settings card
> (recommended conditions), a measured specimen (geometry + mechanical
> properties), or a moisture response (a fitted property-vs-moisture relation).
> 150 columns in 8 blocks, each with a name, type, unit and purpose.

Maintained by Sunnyday Technologies. Apache-2.0. Draft v0.1.0 — a community
specification, not a standards-body publication, and not a certification.

The repository is authoritative. Schema identifiers use the open3dpp.org namespace;
hosting there is configured but not yet deployed, so fetch from the repository.

## Canonical documents
- Repository: https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP
- Current JSON Schema (fetchable, pinned to the release tag):
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/v0.1.0/schemas/core/v0.1.0/open3dpp-record.schema.json
  Its $id is https://open3dpp.org/schemas/core/v0.1.0/open3dpp-record.schema.json —
  a stable identifier, not currently a download location.
- Field reference (150 columns): https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/blob/main/FIELDS.md
- Schema reference: https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/blob/main/Open3DPP_SCHEMA.md
- Changelog: https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- Format research: https://github.com/sunnyday-technologies/Open3DPP/blob/main/research/cura-fdm-material-census/report.md

## How to use it
Validate a record against the schema whose version equals the record's own
`schema_version`. Schemas are closed and version-exact by design.

## What it is not
Not printing or engineering advice. Not a materials database — it hosts no
product data, recommends no settings and ranks no products. Vendor claims
(certifications, safety trait tags, drying limits, hardware requirements) are
recorded exactly as published and are never verified.
